root_cause.text: The driver did not enforce the hardware limitation that the G1 and G2 VPU decoders cannot decode simultaneously on i.MX8MQ, allowing concurrent decoding attempts that cause bus errors and system hangs.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message explicitly state: "For the i.MX8MQ platform, there is a hardware limitation: the g1 VPU and g2 VPU cannot decode simultaneously; otherwise, it will cause below bus error and produce corrupted pictures, even potentially lead to system hang." The patch resolves this by making G1 and G2 share a single v4l2_m2m_dev so that the subsystem can schedule them alternately.
